cohort: 120 children aged 2 years (+-5 months) with a positive family history of atopy, recruited at the Medical University of Varna, Bulgaria.
finding: In children with atopic heredity, early formula feeding, prenatal maternal stress (lower maternal pregnancy experience score), and infection burden (rhinopharyngitis, gastroenteritis) were associated with an increased risk of allergic conditions, while indoor smoking was more common in households of non-allergic children.
